tools.name: amazon_ads_list_profiles

tools.description: List the advertising profiles in AMAZON_ADS_PROFILE_IDS that these credentials can reach in AMAZON_ADS_REGION, with marketplace, account type, currency and timezone. tools.name: amazon_ads_create_report
tools.title: amazon ads create report
tools.description: Request an asynchronous Amazon performance report: Sponsored Products campaigns, ad groups, placements, search terms or advertised products; Brands campaigns, ads or search terms; Display campaigns or products. Brands legacy campaign reports exclude multi-ad-group campaigns. Does not change advertising or budgets. Choose the attribution window explicitly, keep jobToken and call amazon_ads_get_report later. No polling loop, no cross-platform attribution and no automatic sums.

accountId.description: Advertising profile ID listed in AMAZON_ADS_PROFILE_IDS, such as 1234567890. The region-qualified form used by hosted getmcpads, such as EU:1234567890, is accepted when its region matches AMAZON_ADS_REGION.

startDate.description: First day of the report, YYYY-MM-DD, in the profile timezone.

endDate.description: Last day of the report, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 30 days after startDate.

reportType.description: Native report type. sp* reports cover Sponsored Products, sb* Sponsored Brands and sd* Sponsored Display.

attributionDays.description: Native click attribution window in days for purchases and sales. Brands and Display accept 14 only. Never compare different windows as equivalent.

timeUnit.description: Daily rows, or one aggregate row per grouping over the requested range.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.
